t: The Magnusson Tilt 330 rechargeable LED inspection light provides versatile illumination for various manual tasks. Combining a wide work light with a focused torch, this tool delivers up to 330 lumens of brightness. This hand-held light is ideal for automotive mechanics, electricians and plumbers working in cramped spaces under sinks or vehicle bonnets. A 360° rotating body allows precise light positioning, whilst the built-in magnetic base and integrated hanging hook enable hands-free operation. Tradespeople can recharge the unit using the included USB cable, ensuring up to 7 hours of continuous runtime.
b: With Magnet & Hook for Hands-Free Working
